title: On Mitigating Data Sparsity in Conversational Recommender Systems
abstract: arXiv:2507.00479v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Conversational recommender systems (CRSs) infer user preferences from dialogue contexts, but they suffer from severe data sparsity in both dialogue and entity spaces. Dialogue data are linguistically diverse and open-ended, making it difficult to generalize across varied expressions. Meanwhile, existing CRS models often rely on large knowledge graphs, where only a small fraction of entities receive effective supervision during training, leaving the majority under-trained or entirely unseen at inference time. To address these challenges, we propose DACRS, a novel CRS framework consisting of three modules: Dialogue Augmentation, Knowledge-Guided Entity Modeling, and Dialogue-Entity Matching. The Dialogue Augmentation module adopts a two-stage augmentation pipeline to enrich dialogue contexts and improve robustness to linguistic variation. The Knowledge-Guided Entity Modeling module leverages knowledge graphs through entity substitution

translated_title: 缓解对话推荐系统中的数据稀疏性问题
translated_abstract: arXiv:2507.00479v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：对话推荐系统（CRSs）从对话上下文中推断用户偏好，但在对话和实体空间中都面临严重的数据稀疏性问题。对话数据在语言上多样且开放式，难以在不同表达中泛化。同时，现有的CRS模型通常依赖大型知识图谱，其中只有一小部分实体在训练期间获得有效监督，导致大多数实体训练不足或在推理时完全未见。为解决这些挑战，我们提出了DACRS，一种新颖的CRS框架，包含三个模块：对话增强、知识引导实体建模和对话-实体匹配。对话增强模块采用两阶段增强流程来丰富对话上下文并提高对语言变化的鲁棒性。知识引导实体建模模块通过实体替换利用知识图谱。
tldr: DACRS框架通过对话增强、知识引导实体建模和对话-实体匹配三个模块，有效缓解了对话推荐系统中的数据稀疏性问题。
en_tdlr: The DACRS framework alleviates data sparsity in conversational recommender systems through three modules: dialogue augmentation, knowledge-guided entity modeling, and dialogue-entity matching.
